snippet.title: Dwarf Fortress Adventure Mode - Out Now - Official Release Trailer
snippet.description:
As explained here by its co-creator Tarn Adams, Dwarf Fortress Adventure Mode is now available on Steam and itch.io. Buy it here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/975370/Dwarf_Fortress/

Videographer: Vanessa Williams (http://notthatvanessawilliams.com/)
Audio Design & Music: Omar "Dabu" Dabbous (https://www.dabuaudio.com/)

➫Join the Official Dwarf Fortress Discord: https://bit.ly/3W1HvfX
➫Sign up for Dwarf Mail: https://bit.ly/3uYfudW
